findings.text: Matches #168: OnboardingConnectionsView shows Continue when at least one app is ready (unready apps skipped) and 'Skip for now' when none are, so 'Continue and Skip ... work even when an app agent fails its check' is accurate. The 'you can connect that app later' claim rests on code (skipped apps stay selected, a 'You can connect later' line shows) but was not live-tested, per owner. Acceptable as written; consider 'stays selected so you can connect it later' only if softening is wanted.

ChatGPT 26.1111 'Do anything' label is accepted in ChatGPTAppObservation and DesktopAccessibility.isComposer (#175), and an empty box with that label reads as empty. 'connects again' is supported (Connect verified live); a real send through the new composer was not verified, and the line correctly does not claim sending.

Matches #173: releaseStaleDesktopRequests marks unresolved native attempts .dismissed after 15 minutes (checked every 60 s, so up to about 16 min, and skipped while a send is in flight), same status as acknowledgeIncompleteRequest/Stop waiting, nothing resent. 'As if you had pressed Stop waiting' covers the accepted behaviour that an answer arriving after the clear is dropped, but the note does not say so explicitly; optional wording: 'a late answer is not attached'. Scope is Mac app agents (provider.desktopApp), matching the wording.

Matches #172: Connect and an explicit send open claude://claude.ai/new while msgblast holds the foreground; background checks and polling only report and never navigate. 'msgblast opens a new chat for the check' is true for Connect/send, not for passive background checks. Red failed-check text is in DesktopAppSetupView (d75b4d7). No claim of live verification is made.

Diagnostics line matches #170/#171: five keys (accessibility, screenRecording, contacts, messagesDatabase, messagesAutomation) added to the opt-in payload, and the in-app preview (diagnosticsPreview -> diagnosticsJSON) includes them. Values are allowed/off/notRequested/restricted/notConnected/unknown, so 'whether ... are allowed' is a fair summary. Alexa line is #160 (a3701c9, untagged, not in v0.11.0), correctly included; Mac, iPhone and MCP behaviour matches its commit message. Operational reminder, not a notes defect: deploy the feedback Worker (#170) before shipping the client.

Completeness: every user-visible merged change is covered (#168, #169, #170/171, #172, #173, #175, #160); nothing listed that did not ship. Lines 2 and 4 overlap (#169 described twice) but are not inaccurate. Highlights: no 0.11.1 entry in highlights.json, so the first three bullets (setup finish, Claude/Muse connect, ChatGPT connect) are what What's New shows; they read well, though the Busy fix may arguably be more notable than line 2. Format matches 0.11.0 (plain bullets, '## Contributors', linked @handles); @derektraini is credited because commit cf75940 says 'Reported by derektraini on X'. No IPs, usernames beyond public GitHub handles, tailnet names or paths. Diff vs merge-base a3701c9 touches only release-notes/0.11.1.md (+12 lines, 1 file).

notes: No blockers or should-fix items. Claims are supported by merged code; only caveats are the untested 'connect later' claim and the unsent-ChatGPT-composer send, neither overclaimed.
